limits: AT masking at video probability 0.5 produces duplicate normalized polynomial columns. With C fixed, this changes effective ridge regularization relative to AVT. The comparison is between separately regularized feature models, not an equal-capacity proof of video necessity.
All optimizer statuses are retained, but failed optimizer iterates are not rejected. The final report must explicitly summarize convergence failures if any.
Six validation actors were historically exposed. Actor bootstrap intervals are descriptive development intervals and cannot establish new independent population generalization.
No original-test, eight-actor reevaluation, or actor-1019 inputs are evaluated in this workflow.
This static review does not validate computed results, total execution cost, video adoption, or analytic-core superiority.

resolved_findings.issue: TRAINING.json was used for feature selection without enforcing its candidate-freeze hash.
resolved_findings.resolution: evaluate now verifies training_sha256 before reading selection metadata.

resolved_findings.issue: Restored numerical input caches could change after their restoration checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: candidate freeze binds INPUT_IDENTITY.json; evaluate checks its digest; load verifies every split array and accessed cache file against exact recorded SHA256 before np.load.

review_scope: Independent read-only review of source and protocol before validation execution; no validation features, labels, or predictions were opened by this reviewer.
